verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਜੈਸੇ ਰੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਤ ਸੇਤਾਂਬਰ ਹੁਇ ਤੈਸੇ ਤੈਸੋ ਰੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਲਪਟਾਇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise jaise ra(n)g sa(n)g milat setaa(n)bar hui taise taiso ra(n)g a(n)g a(n)g lapaTai hai ||

en.bdb: Every fibre of a white cloth in contact with any colour acquires the same hue.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਗਵਤ ਕਥਾ ਅਰਾਧਨ ਕਉ ਧਾਰਨੀਕ ਲਿਖਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਤਾਸ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਬੰਧ ਮੋਖਦਾਇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: bhagavat kathaa araadhan kau dhaaraneek likhat kirataas patr ba(n)dh mokhadhai hai ||

en.bdb: Paper made of kritas leaf (considered to be impious) when used for recording the praises and paeans of the Lord, becomes capable of freeing one from the bondage of repeated births.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੀਤ ਗ੍ਰੀਖਮਾਦਿ ਬਰਖਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਬਰਖ ਮੈ ਨਿਸਿ ਦਿਨ ਹੋਇ ਲਘੁ ਦੀਰਘ ਦਿਖਾਇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: seet greekhamaadh barakhaa tirabidh barakh mai nis dhin hoi lagh dheeragh dhikhai hai ||

en.bdb: The periods of day light and the ambient conditions varies during summer, rainy season and winter;

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਚਿਤ ਚੰਚਲ ਚਪਲ ਪਉਨ ਗਉਨ ਗਤਿ ਸੰਗਮ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਬਿਰਗੰਧ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇ ਹੈ ॥੧੫੬॥
verses.translit_en: taise chit cha(n)chal chapal paun gaun gat sa(n)gam suga(n)dh biraga(n)dh pragaTai hai ||156||

en.bdb: So is the instable and frolicsome mind that blows like breeze. The air acquires fragrance or foul smell when it passes over stacks of flowers or heap of filth. Similarly a human mind acquires good traits in the company of good persons and ill traits when in contact with evil persons. (156)
